lines.en: I know, you see, somehow the world will change for me, and be so wonderful.
Live life, breathe air, I know somehow we're gonna get there, and feel so wonderful.
It's all for real, I'm telling you just how lucky it all, so wake up the members of my nation, it's your time to be.
There's no chance unless you take one, and the time to see the brighter side of every situation.
Some things are meant to be, so give me your best and leave the rest of me.
Leave it all to me, leave it all to me, just leave it all to me.
